metadata.title: Liminal Village - Application
metadata.description: Let's get to know you better! Please complete this application form.
metadata.completionMessage: Thank you for your application to Liminal Village! We will review it and get back to you soon.

sections.title: Personal Information
sections.description: Let's start with some basic information about you.

sections.label: Role in Regenerative Network
sections.prompt: What role do you have, or could imagine for yourself within a regenerative network?

descriptions.pollinator: Works with different hubs, networking and sharing knowledge, ideas and competencies
descriptions.facilitator: Supports hubs in organising and realising their vision
descriptions.storyteller: Creates and broadcasts narratives about what's happening in the network
descriptions.forager: Supports hubs or the network in attracting resources
descriptions.hub_founder: Has founded, or would like to found a hub
descriptions.hub_steward: Stewards, or would like to steward a hub

sections.title: Visit Information
sections.description:
We often welcome guests around the New Moon (or Full Moon), but the timing is flexible and can be adjusted together.

Please check your calendar with our arrivals around new moons: https://www.timeanddate.com/moon/phases/

sections.label: Arrival Date
sections.prompt: If you would like to visit, what arrival date feels right for you?

sections.label: Departure Date
sections.prompt:
Around what date would you expect to leave?

(Please note: we ideally operate around month-long lunar cycles)

sections.label: Intention for Visiting
sections.prompt: What is your intention for visiting?

sections.label: Mode of Transportation
sections.prompt:
Which mode of transportation will you use to reach Liminal Village?

(You may select more than one)

sections.label: Driver's License
sections.prompt: Do you have an (international) driver's licence?

sections.label: Accommodation Preference
sections.prompt: What type of accommodation would you like to use during your stay at Liminal Village?

options.label: ❓ I'm not sure yet / I need more information

sections.title: About You
sections.description: Tell us something about yourself and your background.

sections.label: Ikigai
sections.prompt:
Tell us something about yourself. What is your Ikigai?

(e.g. healer, leader, facilitator, coach, community organizer, performer, artist, etc.)

sections.label: Background
sections.prompt: Any background you would like to share with us?

sections.label: Community Experience
sections.prompt: Do you have any experience living in (intentional) communities, cohousing or ecovillages? Which ones? Can you tell us something about your experiences?

sections.label: Wellbeing Conditions
sections.prompt: Do you have any current wellbeing conditions (physical, emotional, or psychological) that we should be aware of to ensure that your stay is appropriate and safe for you?

sections.title: Contribution & Exchange
sections.description:
🌿 Liminal Village is part of a growing local–global regenerative network working toward a new way of living—more connected, balanced, and life-supporting.

During your stay, we ask you to contribute in ways that nourish yourself, the community, the commons, and the village projects.

🌕 For volunteers, we ask for a minimum stay of one lunation (1 month) and 20 hours per week. For shorter stays, we ask for a financial contribution.

sections.label: Roles & Tasks
sections.prompt: Which roles or tasks would you like to be involved in?

options.label: Anchoring the kitchen (menu planning, food acquisition)

sections.otherPrompt: Please describe other roles or tasks you'd like to be involved in:

sections.label: Contribution Preference
sections.prompt: How would you prefer to contribute to the community?
sections.otherPrompt: Please describe your preferred contribution arrangement:

descriptions.volunteering: Practical tasks, roles, community support (min 20 hrs/week for 1 month)
descriptions.mixed: Combination of volunteer hours and financial contribution

sections.label: Capacity to Contribute
sections.prompt: What is your capacity to contribute? How many hours per week can you offer, and how many hours are you currently committed to in your regular work or other obligations?

sections.label: Social Media & Websites
sections.prompt: Please share any websites and social media profiles (e.g. Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, etc.)
